label: vision_footnote
text: Paul Revere, son of Mr. and Mrs. William Auerhumer, boasts of being the great, great grandson of the famous Paul Revere, whose ride through to Lexington is one of the greatest events in American history. The little fellow is fond of horses, but now they are of the toy variety.

label: vision_footnote
text: Countess Kitty Schoenborn, formerly Miss Katherine Wolff, surprised her friends by marrying Baron Eugene de Rothschild, one of the richest men in Europe. She was recently divorced from Count Schoenborn.

label: vision_footnote
text: The Aretle romance of Mr. and Mrs. Harold Nolce of two years ago has been shattered. Nolce was the leader of the famous Steffanson relief party which went to Wrangel Island in 1928, to find only one member—Adie Bladyde--alive. Later he met Miss Frances Allison. They were married, but their romance was short lived.

label: vision_footnote
text: A 60-foot plunge down the rocky Palisades at Edgewater, simply resulted in the scratches which show on the face of Miss Jennie Parnia. Fellow members of a walking party found her sitting up at the base of the cliff.

label: vision_footnote
text: The first Jewish University in Palestine was dedicated recently with impressive ceremonies. Leaders of the Zionist movement throughout the world attended the dedication. The photo shows a general view of the ceremonies at Mount Scopush, Palestine, the Grand Rabbi of Palestine. Dr. Abraham Isaac Kook, delivering the principal address.

label: text
text: It Miss Jewell Carmen, moving picture actress, can prove she was born in 1897, she may collect $44,500 for which she is suing two movie companies. Miss Carmen broke a contract and she claims they tied up her services so that she lost a $450-a-week contract. She says the contract was illegal because she was under twenty-one when she sighed it.

label: text
text: Governor Mirisa Ferguson, of Texas, recently created the grand son, Ernest Nalle, a full-fledged colonel on her staff. The "Little Colonel," whose honours abash him not so far what, is believed to be the youngest officer of his rank in the world.

label: text
text: Mr. Winston Churchill, Chancellor of the Exchequer, announced Great Britain would return to the gold standard immediately. Samuel Untermyer, noted lawyer, in speech, assigned Professor Philip Marshall Brown of Princeton University, for his attack on the Jews as lacking patriotism. Senator Moses, president pro tem of the Senate, declared Vice-President Dawes would get no aid from him in his campaign to change rules of the Senate. Brigadier-General James F. Fechst, who succeeded Col. Mitchell as Chief of America's Air Service stated that the air forces should eventually be separated from army and navy control.
